BrochureContent.Content:
Kelly Hudson Properties present this homely 3 bed detached property on c.0.66acre site to the market.

Enjoy the benefits of county life living with this spacious & cosy home c. 133 sqm with extra attic space. This family home comes to the market in great condition throughout and has been well maintained by its current owners. 

It compromises of kitchen with French doors leading to garden area, sitting room with fireplace with wrought iron insert and polished hearth, fully plumbed utility room with back door leading to garden area, Guest WC,  Main bathroom with bath and separate shower, WHB/WC, Three bedrooms– all  have a TV point and wooden flooring. Patio area to the rear and gravel entrance and drive with lighting.

Situated just over 1 kms from the primary school, Carbury is little over 6kms and Derrinturn is 5kms. The larger town of Edenderry is approx 11km. The vibrant Carbury GAA club is also on your doorstep. Expect to be impressed. Viewing is highly recommended!
